newsitem.title: USA: Pea sees more aviation pacts in Latin America.
newsitem.headline: Pea sees more aviation pacts in Latin America.

text.p: U.S. Transportation Secretary Federico Pea said Tuesday he expected the U.S. government would reach more aviation agreements with Latin American nations along the lines of those reached with Argentina, Brazil and Peru.
"We will continue to work with all the nations in the hemisphere in that direction," he told the Americas Conference on Aviation in Miami.
Pea, who spent two hours Tuesday touring Miami International Airport, also called for the establishment of uniform international safety and security practices.

He said that, while U.S. safety reviews of foreign airlines had been met by some resistance, notably after a handful of carriers were barred from the U.S. market, support for the reviews had been growing.
"Now there is broader support for safety reviews," Pea said.
He said 50 safety assessments had been performed, including virtually all of Latin America, and that he expected the rest would be done by the end of 1996.
